Scenes, skies, spawns and build boxes come from Lxzxrus-Free-Realms-Server@37ef175 src/Resources/Zones/hsg_*.json Housing zone records (AlchemyDevelopment/Sanctuary housing data, generated in commit 03c251e) wherever that scene has one, except property 2's build box, which is the in-game !whereami readings in Lxzxrus commits 7ef1743 and e1dbdae; the skies of properties 18 and 26-29 come from Lxzxrus-Free-Realms-Server@37ef175 docs/research/housing-scout.md:113-145, property 25's starter row keeps the sky_test.xml placeholder (its scout sky is sky_sunstone_valley24, R), property 29's scene is the scout table's unverified hsg_hum_snowhill_01 (R), and properties 26-28's scenes are named by the client's Assets_manifest.txt lines 72611, 72694 and 73003; the closed farms 33-34 are the scout table's rows 144-145. Property 25 (Wilds Condo) is the starter; its icon names the client-manifest scene hsg_hum_condo_w_lot. Scene transition defaults (zone_type 2, geometry 214) remain reconstructed. No client property-to-scene map exists. No Legacy source code copied.
client_evidence: client: notes/Build Guides/Gameplay/Housing.md#Data-and-formats lists housing UI/placement resources; no client lot/zone/build-box table.
client: working OSFR Client Resources/Images/Images.txt resolves each Legacy IconId to a named icon; the client does not link those icons to scenes.
community-manifest: lab/references/osfr-asset-manifest/Assets_manifest.txt lists 24 hsg_emptylot scene names; it supplies no property association.
R: scene candidates match the regional/product words in the client icon asset names; ambiguous or generic rows stay disabled.

R: Legacy six-float bounds and spawn values remain provisional where no Lxzxrus zone file exists; scene transition type and geometry defaults are still placeholders pending native evidence; every enabled lot except the lead-owned starter (property 25, which keeps sky_test.xml) names a sky file shipped in the client's Resources/SKY folder (T516).

R: property 25 (Wilds Condo, name_id 296) is the starter type: the wiki records it as every new player's starter from 2012-01-26 (notes/Research/Pieces/021 Property acquisition.md:107-108) and the client locale's decorating tutorial says 'your new Wilds Condo'; starter grant is one per character, and characters already holding property 1 also receive it once.

R: starter_kit (L040): a new Wilds Condo comes with one Chicken 70429 in the bag, its own unstacked row (the client decorating tutorial lists ItemID 70429 first while TutorialArrow:TutorialActive(), ScriptsBase.lua:33599-33606; client Models.txt 535 chicken.adr) and four Basic Square Blocks 32647 standing in the lot (locale objective 'Redecorate your Wilds Condo by moving some of the blocks it came with'; Legacy ClientItemDefinitions.json 32647 hsg_block_01.adr, client Models.txt 1926). Granting the Chicken, the block item (not the captured 7466) and the count and positions (2 m apart, 6 m in front of the spawn at spawn height) are reconstructed; both items resell for 0 (free issuance).

client: property 25's box stays the Legacy value (R) and fits the client's own scene: the Wilds Condo building objects (hsg_hum_condo_w_lot walls, roof, floor, exterior_trims _01) stand at (128.0, -0.97, -28.0) in chunk hsg_hum_condo_w_lot_0_-4, and their unrotated model bounds give x 116.8..137.8, z -36.6..-14.2 (the rotation word is not decoded), inside x 87.2..138.3, z -47.7..-11.6. No 127/28 of this lot exists in the community-preserved p2.pcap client capture (it is another lot). The client reads both corners verbatim (sub_AB3710) and its containment test sub_105C290 ignores w.
